DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"RELIANCE"}, 'nifty50_stocks'[NSE_Ticker])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Date'[Date],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Closing_Price", 'stock_prices'[Closing Price],
			"v50_day_avg", 'stock_prices'[50 day-avg],
			"v200_day_avg", 'stock_prices'[200 day-avg]
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample = 
		SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX(
			3500,
			__DS0Core,
			'Date'[Date],
			[Closing_Price],
			[v50_day_avg],
			[v200_day_avg],
			350,
			,
			ALPHABETICAL,
			ASC,
			105000,
			60
		)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyBinnedSample

ORDER BY
	'Date'[Date]

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	TREATAS({"RELIANCE"}, 'nifty50_stocks'[NSE_Ticker])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(__DS0FilterTable, "Stock_1Y_Return__", IGNORE('stock_prices'[Stock 1Y Return %]))
